review_description: Sales and quoting process was excellent. Knowledgeable workers.Polite and punctual.Delivery of equipment could have been better communicated.

The sales process was a bit clunky.  They originally provided me with a few options/estimates which I found a little confusing before sending around their specialist to do a site inspection and provide a guaranteed quote.  During the site inspection the specialist was the only one who actually got up on my roof, listened to my concerns about string vs optimised panels and provided some good advice on how to use the system once it was up and running.The installers were lovely and polite, arrived on time on both days and left the outside clean and tidy at the end of both days of the install.  The finished job with the battery and inverter looks lovely and neat.

The sales quoting was excellent though took some time comparing different quotes.The installation was timely, and went smoothly. I was informed of the process every step of the way. The only very minor niggle was I had to chase up the 2nd day for installation as it couldn't be completed in one day.Customer service has been excellent throughout. the whole process. I was shown how everything works and they organised the grid connection post installation.Overall I'm extremely satisfied how the whole process went.

The Sales / Quoting process from Helcro Solar was great.  They responded to my queries and requests for tweaks with prompt responses and came up with the best value for money quote.The installer, I think, was a subcontractor to Helco and was neat and competent.  However, I was asked to pay a further $1000 by the installer to make my switchboard fully compliant despite the accepted quotation including $1050 for Partial Blackout Protection circuits and compliant componentry.  I feel I am being over charged for a couple of breakers here and this should have been included in the original scope of works.The old decommissioned solar system and pile of packaging from the new system was left in my driveway for a week and was only removed when I followed it up with Helcro.  I think this was another oversight by the subcontract installer.The Independent Inspector came 3 days after the installation on a Saturday morning and was quick and pleasant to deal with.  The system was put into service and is working perfectly.  One query I had with the Inspector related to the installation of a smoke detector above the battery as this was not done by the installer.  He explained that technically this was not a "shall" be installed but just a "should" be installed requirement and suggested I get one from Bunnings myself.The panels have been installed as designed but some seem to be sitting a little bit out of plane alignment.To date there has been no explanation of the System.  The MySigen phone App is easy enough to understand but a better understanding of the System and Gateway would be helpful.

Helcro Solar was quick to quote with multiple options and all the information that I needed to decide.They were responsive to my phone inquiries.The installation was completed on the agreed date with a high degree of professionalism.Overall, I am happy with how everything went.I am now waiting for the inspector to come and give the final tick off/commissioning.NB: Tried to upload a photo but it didn't work.  Issue with webpage.

Once signedn, HelcroSolar was responsive to any request which was impressive given the increased business associated with the opening of the Federal rebate. The process was fully described with HelcroSolar facilitating paperwork and keeping us appraised of timeliness.

Great experience started with Craig who arranged for Ben to come out and do a site inspection to prepare the quote. Both were extremely helpful. When Ben arrived he was thorough, knowledgeable and extremely helpful. He guided me through the process and set expectations for the whole process. We made the decision to go with Helcro Solar based on this experience. Installation was booked soon after. The crew that arrived had the job done same day.  They were efficient and when they finished the left the job site clean and in the same state they found it. Very professional. After installation, they took care of connection to the grid and worked with the power company on our behalf. Great service. Would thoroughly recommend Helcro Solar to anyone looking at installing solar.

This was a tricky roof space with two other companies refusing to even come and look for a quote saying the roof is too small. Helcro took the time and put in extra effort to find a solution and managed to install a 5kw system. They had multiple options at different price points, it was always going to be a bit extra for us to get solar but Helcro made it possible.

We needed the existing gas hot water service located inside our house replaced with a heat pump in the backyard, and solar panels installed on a steeply pitched double storey roof with shading issues. Helcro were the only company that came on site to inspect and provide a detailed quote. Installations went smoothly and their processes to claim rebates are easy to follow. All trades were professional and work completed as scheduled. Heat pump and solar panels working well and I’m  a happy customer. Thanks Helcro.

Quick reply to online SolarQuotes enquiry. Site visit by Ben and identification of potential issues with aerial views taken and roof top visit (a big feat given pitch of our roof)Quotes arrived promptly from Craig who was happy to adjust design and discuss alterations and alternative designs and components.Everything went quite smoothly
Helcro were outstanding in all aspects of the project. I couldn't recommend them more highly.
I expected everything to go smoothly but it didn't. The Vendor was responsive and managed to get everything sorted out.

The process from getting a quote till installation went really smoothly and ease. They were very effective in communication and gave detailed report/information about the various options for battery, panels, inverter. The people who came to install were very helpful and friendly - they explained and left instructions how to use the battery, inverter and even the switch board. Everything was really clear, transparent and detailed. I was really impressed at their ability, performance and quality service they provided for us.
The install was a replacement for 15 year old panels.  All went well.
Great install thanks guys very respectable team and office staff
Staff were all very knowledgabe and very patient.No one pushed me into anything. They were all very understanding.Thank you so much.I have a shingle roof and the team didn't let me down.

The Helcro Solar sales process was the best I experienced out of 6 installers who quoted me. Marian spent considerable time explaining the advantages of different systems using clear language and also sent emails summarising the phone discussions. They were the only installer who offered to send someone on site rather than just quote through the software.The quoted price was a little higher than some other installers however I believe you get what you pay for - lowest price is not always the best. The installers arrived on schedule and were quite unobtrusive whilst working. They removed all the rubbish at the end of the job and fixed all the roof tiles that were broken. They also fixed a minor electrical fault that arose on the second day.The administration of the project was all done promptly and correctly by the Helcro Office, including emails explaining the entire process.

Helcro’s recently installed a 6.6kW Solar System and a 10kw battery in my house. The experience I have with Helcro has been fabulous, from the beginning of seeking for quotes to the application of rebates and installations.I sought for a number of quotes from different companies, but Helcro win my complete trust in advising me the best product that suit my needs and budget, and that they will do the best job with the installation. Marian, the sale manager at Helcro is amazing. She is knowledgeable, responsive, professional and friendly. She gives me full attention and understanding my needs before responding. Before finalising the quote, an electrician also came to my house and climbed to the roof to inspect (which I greatly appreciated). Upon accepting the quote, Helcro processed the SolarVic rebate within 24 hours. The operation team and Jenny are very responsive in keeping us posted with the installation schedule. The installation took 3 days. On the third day, someone at the Government (Energy Safe Vic) came to do a compliance check before the solar system is commissioned. Shout out to the installation team and the electrician (Bradley)!!! They are very professional and respectful. They communicate clearly and transparently. They give me an update of the installation progress at the end of each day. The installation only finished yesterday and I am very pleased with this process so far!Overall, I highly recommend Helcro. I get what I pay for and I have faith in Helcro’s capability to do the best installation.

Sales/quoting process.Extremely patient, knowledgeable and supportive staff who was able to answer my many questions. He was also very helpful in sourcing the products that we preferred.InstallationInstallation team was punctual and polite. Installation went smoothly abate the change of dates due to staff illness and inclement weather. Safety procedures were strictly adhered to all the time.Customer serviceTen out of ten. We had numerous questions post-installation. They were answered by the appropriate staff and we also had a visit from one of the co-owners. He went through the emergency procedures with us again and explained the functions of the various switches in the switchboard.Overall, we are very impressed with the services provided by the whole team, from the initial site assessment to the post-installation visit.Highly recommend their services.

Helcro Solar was the slowest and most expensive of 3 quotes I received from SolarQuotes.  I chose Helcro because its staff and team appeared to be most knowledgeable of the trade and most professional.  I do not regret my decision.Sales person was thorough and patient with my questions.   He provided with sound advice  and rationales why Goodwe was chosen.  He was knowledgable about potential issues with other products, which I verified independently.An electrician was attended a site visit with detailed photos and videos recording the condition of my roof, switchboard, and discussed potential location for battery.  Orientation of PV panels were justified.  He also explained some of the issues that I may not have been aware of.  Eg only part of the house will be connected to battery so to conserve battery in case of extended power outage without great impact on the running of the house.  We also discussed why I would not benefit from a bigger system, which I was skeptic for a while.  Now I see Helcro provided an excellent advice especially after learning about export limits and my actually power consumption.Excellent communication from Helcro with prompt follow up on my solar applications.  Installation team was on time, in fact early, which is rare amongst tradies.  Work site was nearly maintained.  I can only assume installation was done with care.We had some issue connecting the battery.  The operation team acted on it almost immediately.   A second person came in to have the problem rectified.Unlike some of the installers, customer services become poor post installation, Helcro has been excellent with customer services post installation.  I was ignorant with export limits and a few other issues.  Helcro responded to my queries promptly, on numerous occasions.

Took longer than I expected hence the 4 star on installation, but to be fair, that was beyond anyone's control eg., COVID, unexpectedly finding an asbestos pipe that had to be removed, then a roof problem, damaged inverter sent which had to be replaced.Helcro were able to install new electric HWS too, which was a decider for me, as well as the many good reviews.Ben and his team were great and deserving of the reviews.Solar system is 4.8w and HSW system is air pump (additional cost)Helcro also gave me advice on location of battery and what I need to do to make the location compliant (that's for next year) and Ben even came up with a solution about getting power to my new kitchen as part of a kitchen reno..

Gave high, medium and usable quotes. By that I mean we have a heritage home which means panels can't be placed on the front of the home. The best aspect as its north facing. We went with the usability maximum number of panels we can fix on the roof without having to seek a permit.  We have 8 panels on the roof angled to catch the sun and two on a nearby shed.The installation was smooth, the explained in layman's terms, the process. Very happy the we're punctual ,tidy and s pleasant team to deal with.  A great recommendation thank you. Included are photos.  Feel free to use them!!

Right from the very start, service was excellent. Ben came around for a site inspection, which was very useful. Other installers just quoted based on aerial photographs, which didn't pick up the shading issues from neighboring buildings. Helcro was very quick to provide the quote after the site inspection (I don't think Shuey ever sleeps, he would reply to emails at all hours!).The installers were on time and clearly knew their stuff. The installation is neat and tidy, and everyone was very friendly. Can't fault the process or the overall experience. Would definitely recommend!

Helcro were very helpful and patient explaining the process to transition to solar. The site visit was by the company owner Ben who was more focused on the technical aspects of the installation instead of a sales pitch. He inspected the switchboard and climbed the roof to avoid surprises on the day of installation which may have increased costs. A site visit from another Solar installation company was more a sales pitch and would probably have incurred hidden installation costs. Doing your homework is essential and I decided on a Trinia 8.8kW Fronius Symo Gen24 3-phase system was right for us.  Anything bigger would subsidise electricity to your retailer. Do they need it?  Batteries are too expensive for me and become economically viable when they drop to $5000/10KW which can be paid off within 10 years. With the current rate of improvement maybe that will happen next year.Once I signed, the operations team were brilliant. The next day I was messaged the next steps with a timeline. The installation day was booked for 1 week after signing; equipment arriving the day before as promised. The installation team worked from 8am to 4 pm without a break and the system was generating 4 kW by 4:30pm. They also configured the Fronius web app account for me so I can monitor my system anywhere.To avoid surprises or misunderstanding, be present and communicate with the installation team. They want a good result and take pride in their work. One team member noticed a pre-existing leak on my roof which I was able to patch on the day avoiding future pain.Definitely recommend them for your solar installation.Being September, the system is already saving me an average of $2.30/day in electricity which will probably double during the hotter months. If your roof is north facing without overshadowing, electricity will be generated reliably to power your home. What's stopping you?
Excellent . Very happy with the whole process. Would recommend again
Fantastic bunch of guys, very professional and knowledgeable. They were very easy to work with their work was A+.Thank you

I had Helcro Solar install a solar system at my home, and I couldn't be happier with my purchasing experience. From the initial consultation to the final installation, Luke, Lukas, and the entire team were exceptional. They took the time to answer all my questions and provided clear, honest advice on what system would best suit my needs. The installation process was smooth and professional, with the team showing up on time and working efficiently.What stood out the most was their attention to detail and commitment to quality. They made sure everything was done to the highest standard, and they even took the time to explain how the system works once it was up and running.Thanks again to Luke, Lukas, and the whole team for making the process so easy and stress-free!Raph
Ben and Lucas were outstanding in taking us through installing a solar system.Thank you for the fantastic service Helcro!
Great team, great work.Would highly recommend!Josh and the team were fantastic.

Everything from start to finish was done to great satisfaction and professionalism. When I had problem connecting my wifi to the inverter, I was able to get assistance to guide me through how to use the inverter app and connect to the wifi system properly.

I recently had a solar system installed and wanted to share my experience.Sales/Quoting Process:The sales and quoting process was the best of the three quotes I received.Installation:The installation team was tidy, and punctual. There was a minor misunderstanding about the inverter install position, but overall, I am satisfied with the installation.Customer Service:They were very helpful and organized the grid connection after the installation.Overall, I had a positive experience and would recommend their services.

We wanted to choose a local Australian company when we were looking to install our roof solar. We decided on Helcro Solar as they were very responsive, knowledgeable and listened. I had a quote and an inspection to ensure our property was actually going to be giving us the outcome we wanted and there were no installation surprises. All went well and the installers were a delight to deal with, very courteous, respectful of our property and a friendly team. I can recommend Helcro Solar as the whole experience was relatively hassle free, the challenge was dealing with the local registered authorities which is a necessary part of the overall installation. Thank you to Helcro for understanding and listening to theis customer requirements.
Quote on lineSite visitPromptTidyPunctualCleaned up after installatiion

We had an initial discussion with the salesman who impressed me with his knowledge, the owner came to our property to check it was suitable for the installation of the system we had chosen from the options they provided. He was a person I responded to and spent time discussing the process. We were guided through the rebate process and booked an installation once our rebate had been approved. I can recommend Helcro Solar as the installation team were punctual, friendly and respectful of our property. The entire experience was a pleasant one and it is not often you can say that about having any work done to your home these days.
Could not recommend highly enough.  Brilliant service and responsiveness, including after sales service.
The Helcro team got to outcome of a new solar system for my property. There were challenges on the way but eventually all is working well.

Helcro have been a pleasure to deal with at every stage of the process of getting solar installed and I have been very happy with their communication throughout, even after issues beyond both our control meant the installation had to be delayed everything was smoothed out and we got there in the end, very happy with the end result!
Quoting and installation great, customer service was good but not as good as other aspects

The sales/quoting process was very efficient and the company responded to queries very quickly and clearly.The installation went very well, from the planning, scheduling and actual build. The people involved were tidy and polite, and not one roof tile was broken.Customer service was also outstanding with responses provided to several queries during and after the install. They helped the grid connection through the inspectors report.

Living in a town house with little spare space for ugly things, we were very happy with the solution Helcro developed to make solar a hard working but largely invisible part of our home. Good communication, no over selling. And they delivered on time, with little fuss.
New architectural build and Helcro were great. Looks very sleek, modern and unobstrusive from the street. Great job!

The Helcro team installed a PV solar and battery system with friendly service that came from the administration assistant (Jennie) to the senior management team (Lucas and Luke). The installation team was courteous, respectful, informative, skilled, worked with each other very well and tidied up every day.Ben, the lead of the installation team deserves special mention as being diligent, informative and friendly.Weather interrupted the installation but the team was punctual with their time.Installation was complicated by required work on the main switchboard and a new sub-board because of the necessary placement of the inverter and battery some distance away from the main switchboard.
Helcro were the responsive and interested in doing our work and the installation went smoothly.  The system is working well.

Everything   was good. Clean, punctual, tidied up well,  friendly, explained  things. But I think the poor installer  was tired at the end of  2 big days of work. So he had to return to get my signature and then  return again to screw the metre box in tight enough for the lights to  work. Still, overall, very happy!
Very professional team. I am glad I have chosen Helcro for this project. Thanks heaps!

Sales/ quoting was excellent. Helcro listened to my requirements in both price and equipment and came up with an appropriate installation. Solar Quotes was used often to check the quality of the proposal.Installation by Chispa Electric was prompt and efficient, with Andrew very good with explanations as the installation proceeded. The system was inspected in good time, and up and running far in advance of the period expected.

Go Helcro all the way. The team - Luke, Lukas and Ben (installer) are the best suppliers I have worked with whilst building my home. They are responsive, reasonably priced, honest and got the job done. They optimised for what I needed and considered the aesthetics when they were installing. It was like it was their own house. I could really tell they had care and pride in their product.They were knowledgeable and the work that Ben did was a piece of art. All the cabling were contained within the walls neatly and considered its placement with much attention and care.These guys are great. Dont waste your time looking anywhere else.

Quoting and sale process from Lukas and Luke was streamline and smooth. They took to time to call and attend site to answer questions in regards to system sizes and setups.Ben and the Installation team were a breeze, they were tidy, respectful and polite throughout the whole process.We were fortunate to have our system commissioned on the same day as installation.Delighted to have gone with Helcro.
Great communication and the only ones who actually came to my house to inspect it all - for free!

The quoting process was done nicely and smoothly. The price was very competitive and reasonable too. Installation was a breeze. Installers were polite , punctual and tidy. My system is relatively small so didn't take that long to finish.one let down was that on the day they couldn't put the inverter in the garage as discussed without an extra charge. it was put outdoor near the front door. Overall great company.

Sales and quoting service was the better of the two installers who quoted. The installation team was impressive -- no broken tiles, tiles angle ground to give clearance, polite and quick follow-up to an electrical fault which occurred during/after final inspection.Then my troubles started -- the Enphase app claimed twice as much production as was actually happening. It took some time for Helcro to believe me, but when they did the service was exemplary and the problem was found to be an obscure fault originating in the local Enphase equipment suppliers.

The Helcro sales team were always responsive and polite.  In particular they were quick to perform a site visit and were informative throughout the process.  The installation team experienced some difficulties due to rain and with Fronius regarding one of their inverters, neither of which were in their control.  They remained professional and tidy throughout.

Helcro contacted me immediately and began the process of scoping and quoting our job. We have a tricky roof and Helcro were quick to put one of their team on the roof to determine exactly what was possible in terms of panel numbers and their location. They provided a range of options and had the technical support to review and decide upon the ideal solution. Installation was sub contracted to Chispa who did an excellent job.

I am delighted to write a positive review for Helcro Solar and their contractor, Andrew (Chispa Electrical). Their exceptional work installing an additional 10kW solar system and battery backup has left me incredibly impressed and satisfied.From the beginning, the team at Helcro Solar was professional and attentive to my needs. They provided me with a detailed consultation and worked closely with me to design a system that was tailored to my home and energy usage. Their expertise and attention to detail gave me confidence that I was getting the best solution for my needs.Once the design was finalized, Andrew and his team got to work. We had slight delay with the chosen inverter due to supply chain issue, but I was kept informed the whole way.  There were also able to schedule the installation around an unexpected issue to do with an external wall of my house.  On the week of the installation, they were punctual, efficient, and respectful of my property. They took great care to ensure that the installation process was done with minimal disruption to my daily routine. Throughout the installation, Andrew kept me informed of the progress and answered any questions I had.The quality of the workmanship was outstanding, and the system has been running flawlessly ever since.  Despite only running for a couple of days, and the weather has been cloudy, I have seen a significant decrease in the amount of power drawn from the grid with my fronius app, and the battery backup has given me peace of mind during power outages.Overall, I am thrilled with the service provided by Helcro Solar and Andrew. They are true professionals who go above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a high-quality solar system installation. Thank you, Helcro Solar and Andrew, for your excellent work!

Helcro was the first installer I could find that installs on slate roofs after several years of looking .The communication was first class and the installation professional in a period home with unusual challenges . Highly recommended

I felt like I was buying a quality system, not just the cheapest, The install went very smoothly and professionally. Great customer service. I feel I can approach Helcro long after the install date. Still waiting for the grid feed in tariff to be established.

Overall I had a great experience with Helcro Solar. They were very knowledgeable and were able to explain things to me clearly.The installation process was very smooth and professionally done.Everyone I dealt with was very friendly and professional and gave me confidence that the job would be done well. The couple of challenges encountered along the way were handled well.The system is working nicely with no issues so far - I’m very happy.

I recently installed 19 Trina panels and a Fronius Gen24 from Helcro and it all went 100% smoothly. Luke and Lukas were great answering questions and accommodating all of our requests pre-install and Ben did a great job on the day. They were professional, courteous, and didn't leave a mess. They were also able to accommodate setting up a backup solar PV point. I am very happy with the system as installed and it is functioning as it should. They even reached out when the system went offline (due to issues with my wifi, not the inverter). Overall, a great experience!

We’ve been super impressed with Helcro’s team, Luke, Lukas and Ben, who helped us to navigate the daunting process of getting solar from start to finish in just over a month. The system we were quoted was not the cheapest (or most expensive) but it was comprised of a good quality inverter (made in Austria) with very modern looking panels. Unlike the other two companies who provided us with quotes, Helcro made sure they visited the site for full details to ensure the quote fits our site and requirements, this also made for a smoother installation. On the day, Ben and his team powered through the inclement weather and went out of their way to help hide the cabling so that we achieved the most aesthetic outcome possible, not an easy feat with our double brick walls inside and out. Very glad we went with a local business whose owners care about their customers!

All went thru as planned. Installers took the time to find best option as I didn't want any conduit visible on exterior of house. Experienced friendly polite tradesmen cleaned up after completion. They processed necessary paperwork and dealt with service provider AGL. Would highly recommend this company.

Luke from Helcro was excellent, he took the time to explain the value of the various options for panels and inverters. I spoke to several providers who just gave me a quote, rather than taking the time to actually outline the options and benefits of each. This meant I didn't feel stupid for not understanding the tech speak, and now have a really good understanding of how my system works.  Thanks Luke
Excellent service and query response. The whole process was fast and easy. Quick installation and professional installers.
Great customer service, fast installation, quality product, brilliant follow up. Literally couldn’t ask for more. Looking forward to my next electricity bill. Highly recommend Helcro.

The three quotes came in quickly but only one company insisted on a site visit, the other two declined saying it wasn't necessary. Because I was replacing an older 3kW PV only system with a larger system + battery I would only deal with a company that would do a site visit. As it happened Helcro was the most realistic with their assessment pricing was competitive (mid range of the 3) and they communicated with good technical information not a hard sales push. I also chose Helcro also because they used Lithium iron phosphate batteries and for safety and ethical reasons I didn't want cobalt in the battery. Having had solar I had a good idea of the usage pattern and upgraded their suggested battery size by adding an extra module to the BYD battery. Installation process was seamless and everything clicked in after the inspection. However, one month later the system dropped off the app. Turned out it was not a technical hitch with the inverter communicating with the app but a stuff up in the paper work with the energy supplier. Got that sorted and Helcro responded quickly, so now all is forgiven and the system is working brilliantly. Even in the middle of a Melbourne winter there are many days when we don't draw anything from the grid.
Most suppliers had phone people who could hardly speak English.

I got a number of quotes and spoke to each company rep about the system - Helcro were above and beyond the best - factual, straightforward and definitely not a pushy sales pitch. They weren’t the cheapest option, but we chose them because we felt most comfortable with them and the quality of the products they recommended. The actual installation went smoothly, the team were lovely and they cleaned up afterwards.

Helcro have been great to work with throughout the whole process.  There was no hard sell, and they helpfully set out options to cover our unusual system requirements clearly. The team  also provided additional information to assist me in getting planning permission.  The installation itself was done smoothly and the grid connection happened all very promptly.  Post installation I have had a small number of queries and the team have been brilliant at both responding and assisting me on each occasion.  I would be happy to recommend them.

Helcro provided friendly and informative customer service right from the first phone call through to completion of the installation.The installation was very efficient, the work tidy and the on site crew friendly and easy to approach with my many questions. Everyone involved clearly knew what they were doing.Overall I’m very happy and excited with my solar system.Ashley.
- Same day response to our quotation request- Customised panel and inverter arrangement to suit our requirements- Quick turnaround from system specification to  system installation- Friendly service

Sales process was eficient, polite and informed. No hard sell and factual.Installers were an absolute pleasure to have on our property. As we installed a rather large system we had a number of people onsite and everyone of them was an absolute pleasure . They were respectful of our property and work commitments and also genuinely seemed to enjoy working together which is always the sign of a good team and company.Customer service was fantastic and effortless. Good contact by email and phone.Would recommend this firm to everyone and intend to refer to a number of our friends.

Quick response with quote which was slightly cheaper than other similar systems.NO pressure to buy. No upselling.Actually had to upsell myself as I wanted something better than what they suggested.Installation went smoothly and the guys were clearly very experienced.

Feda and the team at Helcro solar did an awesome job instaling a very complex system.Their attention to detail and his passion for his work allowed us to have a system that not many others would be able to achieve.Their communication and follow up has been outstanding and I would highly recommend if your looking for solar.

I selected Helcro after getting quotes from here and another site. Whilst my house on paper didnt present too many challenges, Helcro were the only installer that offered to come out to inspect before quoting. This was important to me as i have a newly built house and the position of the inverter as well as any conduit would impact the appearance.I had a fair idea of the equipment i wanted but they gave some advice here and we went for a slightly larger system.The system has been up and running for around a month and appears to be generating well. The quality of the install is excellent and they have done a great job of minimising the visual impact. All up I am happy with Helcro as my solar installer.

Feda & his team did a fantastic job installing our system.Customer service from Feda has been topnotch. He answers queries straight away either through email or a phone call. He would even call us on a Sunday just to follow up.Feda is the type of person that cares a lot of their work.Very highly recommended.

Feda and the team did an outstanding job both in the communication and the installation process. You can see that they care about their work and follow up customer service.Highly recommended to my friends and family.Vincent
